name: Intra Position Movement Status Advice 002 V 07
definition: Scope|An account servicer sends a IntraPositionMovementStatusAdvice to an account owner to advise the status of an intra-position movement instruction previously sent by the account owner.|The account servicer/owner relationship may be:|- a central securities depository or another settlement market infrastructure acting on behalf of their participants|- an agent (sub-custodian) acting on behalf of their global custodian customer, or|- a custodian acting on behalf of an investment management institution or a broker/dealer.||Usage|The message may also be used to:|- re-send a message previously sent,|- provide a third party with a copy of a message for information,|- re-send to a third party a copy of a message for information using the relevant elements in the Business Application Header.

TransactionIdentification.name: Transaction Identification
TransactionIdentification.definition: Unambiguous identification of a transaction as per the account owner (or the instructing party managing the account).

ProcessingStatus.name: Processing Status
ProcessingStatus.definition: Provides details on the processing status of the transaction.

SettlementStatus.name: Settlement Status
SettlementStatus.definition: Provides the status of settlement of a transaction.

TransactionDetails.name: Transaction Details
TransactionDetails.definition: Identifies the details of the transaction.

SupplementaryData.name: Supplementary Data
SupplementaryData.definition: Additional information that cannot be captured in the structured elements and/or any other specific block.
